---- MODULE ivy_examples_split_queue_2_new ----
EXTENDS ivy_examples_split_queue_2_newDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
LOCAL NI == INSTANCE NaturalsInduction
AgentTypeOK == /\ begun \in [Nat -> BOOLEAN]
               /\ done \in [Nat -> BOOLEAN]
               /\ queue \in [Nat -> BOOLEAN]
               /\ firstq \in Nat
AgentAllDoneBelow(k) == \A y \in Nat : (y < k /\ begun[y]) => done[y]
AgentP1(k) == /\ k \in Nat
              /\ begun[k]
              /\ ~done[k]
              /\ AgentAllDoneBelow(k)
              /\ queue[k]
              /\ AgentTypeOK
AgentP2(k) == /\ k \in Nat
              /\ begun[k]
              /\ ~done[k]
              /\ AgentAllDoneBelow(k)
              /\ ~queue[k]
              /\ AgentTypeOK
AgentP(k) == /\ k \in Nat
             /\ begun[k]
             /\ ~done[k]
             /\ AgentAllDoneBelow(k)
             /\ AgentTypeOK
AgentUndonePost(k, n) == begun[n] /\ ~[done EXCEPT ![k] = TRUE][n]
AgentT(m, k) == /\ m \in Nat
                /\ k \in Nat
                /\ m <= k
                /\ AgentTypeOK
                /\ (AgentAllDoneBelow(m) \/ done[k])
AgentS(m, k) == /\ m \in Nat
                /\ k \in Nat
                /\ m < k
                /\ AgentTypeOK
                /\ (done[m] \/ ~begun[m] \/ done[k])
AgentQ(n) == Spec => (begun[n] ~> done[n])
THEOREM AgentInitType == ASSUME Init PROVE AgentTypeOK
BY DEF Init, AgentTypeOK
THEOREM AgentNextType == ASSUME AgentTypeOK, [Next]_vars PROVE AgentTypeOK'
BY DEF AgentTypeOK, Next, Send, Recv1, Recv2, vars, HasUndoneFrom, FirstUndoneFrom, UpdateFirstq
THEOREM AgentTypeInv == Spec => []AgentTypeOK
BY AgentInitType, AgentNextType, PTL DEF Spec, SafetySpec, Init, Next, vars, AgentTypeOK
THEOREM AgentBegunStable == ASSUME NEW k \in Nat, AgentTypeOK, begun[k], [Next]_vars PROVE begun[k]'
BY DEF AgentTypeOK, Next, Send, Recv1, Recv2, vars, HasUndoneFrom, FirstUndoneFrom, UpdateFirstq
THEOREM AgentDoneStable == ASSUME NEW k \in Nat, AgentTypeOK, done[k], [Next]_vars PROVE done[k]'
BY DEF AgentTypeOK, Next, Send, Recv1, Recv2, vars, HasUndoneFrom, FirstUndoneFrom, UpdateFirstq
THEOREM AgentNotBegunStable == ASSUME NEW k \in Nat, NEW j \in Nat, j < k, AgentTypeOK, begun[k], ~begun[j], [Next]_vars PROVE ~begun[j]'
BY DEF AgentTypeOK, Next, Send, Recv1, Recv2, vars, HasUndoneFrom, FirstUndoneFrom, UpdateFirstq
THEOREM AgentTStable == ASSUME NEW m \in Nat, NEW k \in Nat, m <= k, begun[k], AgentT(m, k), [Next]_vars PROVE AgentT(m, k)'
BY DEF AgentT, AgentAllDoneBelow, AgentTypeOK, Next, Send, Recv1, Recv2, vars, HasUndoneFrom, FirstUndoneFrom, UpdateFirstq
THEOREM AgentSStable == ASSUME NEW m \in Nat, NEW k \in Nat, m < k, begun[k], AgentS(m, k), [Next]_vars PROVE AgentS(m, k)'
BY DEF AgentS, AgentTypeOK, Next, Send, Recv1, Recv2, vars, HasUndoneFrom, FirstUndoneFrom, UpdateFirstq
THEOREM AgentPostExists == ASSUME NEW k \in Nat, HasUndoneFrom(begun, [done EXCEPT ![k] = TRUE]) PROVE \E x \in Nat : FirstUndoneFrom(x, begun, [done EXCEPT ![k] = TRUE])
<1>1. PICK x \in Nat : AgentUndonePost(k, x) BY DEF AgentUndonePost, HasUndoneFrom
<1>2. AgentUndonePost(k, x) BY <1>1 DEF AgentUndonePost
<1>3. HIDE DEF AgentUndonePost
<1>4. \E m \in Nat : AgentUndonePost(k, m) /\ \A j \in 0..(m-1) : ~AgentUndonePost(k, j) BY <1>2, NI!SmallestNatural
<1>5. PICK m \in Nat : AgentUndonePost(k, m) /\ \A j \in 0..(m-1) : ~AgentUndonePost(k, j) BY <1>4
<1>6. USE DEF AgentUndonePost
<1>7. FirstUndoneFrom(m, begun, [done EXCEPT ![k] = TRUE]) BY <1>5 DEF FirstUndoneFrom, AgentUndonePost
<1>8. QED BY <1>7
THEOREM AgentP1St == ASSUME NEW k \in Nat, AgentP1(k), [Next]_vars PROVE AgentP1(k)' \/ done[k]'
BY DEF AgentP1, AgentAllDoneBelow, AgentTypeOK, Next, Send, Recv1, Recv2, vars, HasUndoneFrom, FirstUndoneFrom, UpdateFirstq
THEOREM AgentP1Recv == ASSUME NEW k \in Nat, AgentP1(k), <<Next /\ Recv1>>_vars PROVE done[k]'
BY DEF AgentP1, AgentAllDoneBelow, AgentTypeOK, Next, Send, Recv1, Recv2, vars, HasUndoneFrom, FirstUndoneFrom, UpdateFirstq
THEOREM AgentP1EnNoUndone == ASSUME NEW k \in Nat, AgentP1(k), ~HasUndoneFrom(begun, [done EXCEPT ![k] = TRUE]) PROVE ENABLED <<Recv1>>_vars
<1>1. FirstUndoneFrom(k, begun, done) BY DEF AgentP1, AgentAllDoneBelow, FirstUndoneFrom
<1>2. QED BY <1>1, ExpandENABLED, ENABLEDaxioms DEF AgentP1, AgentAllDoneBelow, AgentTypeOK, Recv1, FirstUndoneFrom, HasUndoneFrom, UpdateFirstq, vars
THEOREM AgentP1EnUndone == ASSUME NEW k \in Nat, AgentP1(k), HasUndoneFrom(begun, [done EXCEPT ![k] = TRUE]) PROVE ENABLED <<Recv1>>_vars
<1>1. FirstUndoneFrom(k, begun, done) BY DEF AgentP1, AgentAllDoneBelow, FirstUndoneFrom
<1>2. \E m \in Nat : FirstUndoneFrom(m, begun, [done EXCEPT ![k] = TRUE]) BY AgentPostExists DEF HasUndoneFrom
<1>3. PICK m \in Nat : FirstUndoneFrom(m, begun, [done EXCEPT ![k] = TRUE]) BY <1>2
<1>4. QED BY <1>1, <1>3, ExpandENABLED, ENABLEDaxioms DEF AgentP1, AgentAllDoneBelow, AgentTypeOK, Recv1, FirstUndoneFrom, HasUndoneFrom, UpdateFirstq, vars
THEOREM AgentP1En == ASSUME NEW k \in Nat, AgentP1(k) PROVE ENABLED <<Recv1>>_vars
BY AgentP1EnNoUndone, AgentP1EnUndone DEF AgentP1
THEOREM AgentP1Lead == ASSUME NEW k \in Nat PROVE Spec => (AgentP1(k) ~> done[k])
BY AgentP1St, AgentP1Recv, AgentP1En, PTL DEF Spec, SafetySpec, Next, Recv1, Recv2, vars, AgentP1, AgentAllDoneBelow, AgentTypeOK
THEOREM AgentWit2 == ASSUME NEW k \in Nat, NEW m \in Nat, AgentP2(k), FirstUndoneFrom(m, begun, [done EXCEPT ![k] = TRUE]), done' = [done EXCEPT ![k] = TRUE], firstq' = m, begun' = begun, queue' = queue PROVE Recv2
BY DEF AgentP2, AgentAllDoneBelow, AgentTypeOK, Recv1, Recv2, FirstUndoneFrom, HasUndoneFrom, UpdateFirstq, vars
THEOREM AgentP2St == ASSUME NEW k \in Nat, AgentP2(k), [Next]_vars PROVE AgentP2(k)' \/ done[k]'
BY DEF AgentP2, AgentAllDoneBelow, AgentTypeOK, Next, Send, Recv1, Recv2, vars, HasUndoneFrom, FirstUndoneFrom, UpdateFirstq
THEOREM AgentP2Recv == ASSUME NEW k \in Nat, AgentP2(k), <<Next /\ Recv2>>_vars PROVE done[k]'
BY DEF AgentP2, AgentAllDoneBelow, AgentTypeOK, Next, Send, Recv1, Recv2, vars, HasUndoneFrom, FirstUndoneFrom, UpdateFirstq
THEOREM AgentP2EnNoUndone == ASSUME NEW k \in Nat, AgentP2(k), ~HasUndoneFrom(begun, [done EXCEPT ![k] = TRUE]) PROVE ENABLED <<Recv2>>_vars
<1>1. FirstUndoneFrom(k, begun, done) BY DEF AgentP2, AgentAllDoneBelow, FirstUndoneFrom
<1>2. QED BY <1>1, ExpandENABLED, ENABLEDaxioms DEF AgentP2, AgentAllDoneBelow, AgentTypeOK, Recv2, FirstUndoneFrom, HasUndoneFrom, UpdateFirstq, vars
THEOREM AgentP2EnUndone == ASSUME NEW k \in Nat, AgentP2(k), HasUndoneFrom(begun, [done EXCEPT ![k] = TRUE]) PROVE ENABLED <<Recv2>>_vars
<1>1. FirstUndoneFrom(k, begun, done) BY DEF AgentP2, AgentAllDoneBelow, FirstUndoneFrom
<1>2. \E m \in Nat : FirstUndoneFrom(m, begun, [done EXCEPT ![k] = TRUE]) BY AgentPostExists DEF HasUndoneFrom
<1>3. PICK m \in Nat : FirstUndoneFrom(m, begun, [done EXCEPT ![k] = TRUE]) BY <1>2
<1>4. QED BY <1>1, <1>3, AgentWit2, ExpandENABLED, ENABLEDaxioms DEF AgentP2, AgentAllDoneBelow, AgentTypeOK, Recv1, Recv2, FirstUndoneFrom, HasUndoneFrom, UpdateFirstq, vars
THEOREM AgentP2En == ASSUME NEW k \in Nat, AgentP2(k) PROVE ENABLED <<Recv2>>_vars
BY AgentP2EnNoUndone, AgentP2EnUndone DEF AgentP2
THEOREM AgentP2Lead == ASSUME NEW k \in Nat PROVE Spec => (AgentP2(k) ~> done[k])
BY AgentP2St, AgentP2Recv, AgentP2En, PTL DEF Spec, SafetySpec, Next, Recv1, Recv2, vars, AgentP2, AgentAllDoneBelow, AgentTypeOK
THEOREM AgentPLead == ASSUME NEW k \in Nat PROVE Spec => (AgentP(k) ~> done[k])
BY AgentP1Lead, AgentP2Lead, PTL DEF Spec, AgentP, AgentP1, AgentP2, AgentAllDoneBelow, AgentTypeOK
\* END AGENT HELPERS

THEOREM Liveness == Spec => WorkCompletion
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF ivy_examples_split_queue_2_new/ivy_examples_split_queue_2_new_Liveness.tla
<1>1. \A n \in Nat : (\A m \in 0..(n-1) : AgentQ(m)) => AgentQ(n)
BY AgentPLead, AgentTypeInv, AgentTStable, AgentSStable, AgentBegunStable, AgentDoneStable, AgentNotBegunStable, PTL DEF Spec, WorkCompletion, AgentQ, AgentP, AgentAllDoneBelow, AgentTypeOK, AgentT, AgentS
<1>2. HIDE DEF AgentQ
<1>3. \A n \in Nat : AgentQ(n) BY <1>1, NI!GeneralNatInduction DEF AgentQ
<1>4. QED BY <1>3, PTL DEF Spec, WorkCompletion, AgentQ
\* END AGENT PROOF ivy_examples_split_queue_2_new/ivy_examples_split_queue_2_new_Liveness.tla
====
